title: MathNet: A Global Multimodal Benchmark for Mathematical Reasoning and Retrieval

layout.note: A central MathNet wordmark with four short colour-matched spokes to rounded colour frames: a tall navy frame at the left (data), a gold frame top middle (solutions), a green frame bottom middle (topics) and a tall red frame at the right (benchmarks); each title is set into the top border of its frame.

lesson: Give a benchmark a hub: the wordmark in the middle, one colour-framed panel per selling point, each titled in its own colour in the frame border and carrying its most convincing visual (bubble chart, map, solution diagrams, ontology cards, task flows).
